name: DetailResource
title: Blocks/Detail/DetailResource
summary: The Overview tab of a resource detail page: the full-bleed tab bar, sticky while the layout scrolls, then the column that opens on the resource summary card. The resource overview follows it with Get started for a resource made from the CLI, and the same page plots its Versions tab (the versions table) and its Build tab (repository, build configuration and token bands); the service overview follows the summary with the production checklist and the deployment topology. The summary card on its own, in its resource, service and policy shapes, is the Resource, Service and Policy variants: a subject band with the primary link and the actions, a band of labelled facts, and a state band on the canvas fill. A deployment's own page (success, failure, queued) is the `detail/detail-deployment-logs` block and one function run is the `detail/detail-invocations` block. The FirstDeploy variant draws the summary cards before and during the first deploy, ResourceBuildConnected the Build tab with a connected repository, and ApplicationBuild the application page with a Build tab and the project drop target. The Application variant is a whole application page with Overview, Versions, Deployments and a Topology tab built on `FlowDiagram`, whose staged binds deploy through a `Drawer` and the Edit and Redeploy toast. The version page of a resource is the `detail/detail-version` block and the deploy drawers opened from these pages are the `create/create-deploy-drawer` block. The Deployments tab of a resource and of a service is the TableView controls row over a deployments table, scoped to the resource (the resource tab adds a small Deployments heading with Documentation and an outlined Deploy action); the service Settings tab is a variant of `edit/edit-resource`. Built from `PageHeader`, `PageTabs`, `Subheader`, `SettingsGroup`, `SettingsRow`, `SaveBar`, `Tabs`, `DataTable`, `EmptyState`, `InputGroupRoot`, `Card`, `DropdownMenu`, `Popover`, `Accordion`, `FlowDiagram`, `Item`, `Drawer`, `Alert`, `CodeBlock` and `ToggleGroup`; the summary card variants add `Button`, `IconButton`, `Tag`, `StatusIndicator`, `Avatar`, `CopyButton` and `Tooltip`. A page body for ConsoleLayout: the layout owns the rail, the header with the breadcrumb (a service's environment crumb is its `breadcrumbs` slot) and the main.

variants.name: Resource
variants.summary: The summary card that opens a resource Overview tab: a subject band with the primary link and the actions, a band of labelled facts, and a state band on the canvas fill. It comes in three shapes — a resource, a service with its domains and environments, and a policy — each with its own facts and copy. Built from `Card`, `Button`, `IconButton`, `DropdownMenu`, `Popover`, `Tag`, `StatusIndicator`, `Avatar`, `CopyButton`, `Accordion`, `Alert` and `Tooltip`.

variants.name: Service
variants.summary: The service summary: the domain with its aliases in the overflow popover, the environment menu (shown below md only; from md up the breadcrumb carries the environment) and actions, the custom domains, status, service ID and creation, and the shared Deployment Settings band that expands into its policies.

variants.name: Policy
variants.summary: The policy summary: the resource it protects, a Rules shortcut and actions, then status, environment, rule count, last edit and the enabled modules, and what the policy inspects.

variants.name: ResourceVersions
variants.summary: The Versions tab of the same resource: the small Versions heading with Add Version, the controls row (Filter, search, Refresh, Download CSV, Columns) and the paginated versions table, each row with its code-set name and Latest mark, the comment, the state Tag, who built it and when, and the Open configuration or Deploy actions.

variants.name: ResourceBuild
variants.summary: The Build tab of a resource made from the CLI: the small Build heading with an outlined Deploy, the Git repository band holding the Connect Git repository card, the Build configuration band with the read-only framework preset and the build and deploy commands, and the Deployment band with the API token. Editing a command raises the save bar.

variants.name: ServiceOverview
variants.summary: A service (its environment crumb is a transparent small select the page sets with `ConsoleLayout.Breadcrumb`): the outlined Deploy action sits on the tab row, the summary carries its Deployment Settings band (its own environment menu shows only below md, where the layout hides the breadcrumb), the production checklist expands into a drawer, and the deployment topology is a `FlowDiagram` from domains to storage, whose Domains node adds a domain from its `actions` slot: Policy, Error Page and Origin are bindable slots whose changes are staged, counted beside Deploy and listed in the deploy drawer, ending in the toast with Edit and Redeploy.

variants.name: Application
variants.summary: An application page body with working tabs: Overview (the summary card with the live address, Visit and actions, the deployment, status, active version, framework, source and creation facts, and a band that sends settings changes to the active version), Versions and Deployments (a small `Subheader` over a `DataTable` each), and Topology, where `FlowDiagram` draws domain, workload, firewall, application and function instance. Binding or removing a firewall or function is staged: the tab row counts the changes in a warning `Tag`, Deploy opens a `Drawer` listing them, and the run reports through the state-async-submit toast with Edit (back to Topology) and Redeploy.

variants.name: NoDeployment
variants.summary: The Overview of a resource that was created but never deployed: the summary reads Not deployed yet in place of the address, None for Deployment and Domains, Not deployed as its status and no Visit, the state band names the three ways to deploy (drop the project, connect Git, or the CLI), and Get started follows.

variants.name: FirstDeploy
variants.summary: The summary cards before and during the first deploy: a resource never deployed (Not deployed yet in place of the address, None for Deployment and Domains, Not deployed as its status, Not yet as its creation, Connect Git repository and Project upload under Source, and the state band naming the three ways to deploy), then two service cards whose Status reads Deploying · Build with a loading `StatusIndicator`, and Inactive.

variants.name: ResourceBuildConnected
variants.summary: The Build tab of a resource with a connected repository: the Git repository band holds the repository link with a danger Disconnect and the Production branch and Preview branch rows, then the Build configuration and Deployment bands. Editing a branch or a command raises the save bar.

variants.name: ApplicationBuild
variants.summary: An application page body with the Overview, Versions, Build and Deployments tabs and no topology: the Overview summary says every push to the production branch deploys and that a project can be dropped on the page; dragging files over the page raises the dashed state-project-intake drop target, and dropping them (or Deploy on the tab row) opens a deploy `Drawer` that names the source and runs through the state-async-submit toast with Edit and Redeploy. The Build tab edits the connected repository branches and the build commands behind a save bar, and leaving it with unsaved changes asks first in a `ConfirmDialog` (`useUnsavedChanges`).
